issues: ENIAC is usually called the first general-purpose electronic computer (earlier electronic machines such as Colossus and the Atanasoff–Berry Computer existed). The IBM PC was released in 1981, but earlier personal computers existed (e.g. Altair 8800 in 1975, Apple II in 1977); "first personal computer … 1981 by IBM" is inaccurate. Recorded as printed.
The QR-code row says a QR code can hold "upto 300 alpha numeric characters"; the largest standard QR code (version 40) can hold up to 4,296 alphanumeric characters. Recorded as printed.
